[[File:2319.png|right]] 23.19 ==The Ruins of Maddlow Castle== Region: [[The Barrier Range]]

Connects to 24.13, 25.17, ''26.20, 29.14.17'' and the '''Duchy of Thring'''.

In a high valley at the center of the Witch Clans' domains, there is a place that they call a ruin but is more accurately the opposite of a ruin - a castle that was only ever half built and then abandoned. Long ago, this place was the seat of power for [[The Maddlows]].

The reason that the castle was never fully built is that each Maddlow suspected the others of inserting secret doors and traps into the design.

====Connection==== *

[[Gischard Penderghast]] (24.13) looted Maddlow Castle some time ago and left its walls perilously full of holes.

[[File:WilliamHenryJamesBoot.jpg|thumb|400px|William James Henry Boot]] ====Hooks==== *

Any truth to the Maddlows' fears about traps and secret passages?
